notes.title: GAME DELAYED + GAMEPLAY TRAILER
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Thanks for all the wishlists for the game! For those who are wondering why the game is not out yet, it is because our team (3 people) is polishing and trying to get as much quality packed into the game as possible.

The delay should only be a couple of days, but due to steams reviewing procedures we must wait until around the 1st to 4th of June, for those with the closed beta, the game will be out for you guys around 29th of June.

THE 10 MINUTE GAMEPLAY TRAILER CAN BE FOUND HERE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ISQVRhO1wfI

Thanks for all of your patience!
- Shanaz
